meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Ultra-compressed commit message generator. Cuts noise from commit messages while preserving intent and reasoning. Conventional Commits format. Subject ≤50 chars, body only when "why" isn't obvious. Use when user says "write a commit", "commit message", "generate commit", "/commit", or invokes /caveman-commit. Auto-triggers when staging changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把暂存变更压缩成简洁的提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次写提交信息都要纠结很久
copy.tagline_en: Compress staged changes into concise commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to write clear commit messages

howto.what: Claude 会按 Conventional Commits 格式生成极简提交信息：主题用祈使句且≤50字符，必要时才加正文（如破坏性变更）。只输出代码块，不运行 git 命令。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”、“commit message”等，或调用 /caveman-commit 时；有暂存更改时也会自动触发。

say.note: Claude 会生成简洁的提交信息。

say.text: 为暂存区生成 commit message
say.note: 它会基于暂存内容输出。

say.text: 用 caveman-commit 写提交信息

howto.what_en: Claude generates terse commit messages in Conventional Commits format: subject in imperative mood, ≤50 chars; body only for non-obvious why, breaking changes, etc. Outputs as a ready-to-paste code block; never runs git commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'write a commit', 'commit message', etc., or invoke /caveman-commit. Also auto-triggers when there are staged changes.

say_en.note: Claude will output a concise commit message.

say_en.text: Generate a commit message for the staged changes
say_en.note: It will use the staged diff to create the message.

say_en.text: Use caveman-commit to write a commit message
